Ava: Quick silly question—If you could send a single postcard to yourself in any year (past or future), what year would you pick and what one-line message would you write?
Diego: 1999 — 'Buy the dip (and maybe a backup of that AIM chat).' :grimace: 
Priya: 2042 — 'Invest in socks with pockets.' (also call Mom)
Liam: 2030 — 'You finally fixed the coffee machine. Don't forget the manual.' :coffee: 
Ava: 2014 — 'Try the internship. Say yes.'
Priya: Haha love that. Short but powerful.
Diego: 1987 — 'You're allowed to dance at prom.' :dancer: 
Liam: 2060 — 'Hi future me, any hoverboards yet?'
Ava: Bonus: if you could sign it with a nickname, mine would be 'Tiny Ava' :heart: 
OpsBot: Poll created: Which year would you choose? 1) Past 2) Near future (next 10 yrs) 3) Far future (50+ yrs)
Diego: Voting 1
Priya: 2
Liam: 2
Ava: 1
Diego: Also love the idea of sending a postcard to 5-year-old me: 'Play piano, not safe-crack.'
Priya: Now I'm imagining a physical mailbox for time-travel postcards. Beautiful chaos.
Liam: If anyone actually mails one, drop a photo in #random-mailbox :postal_horn: 
Ava: This made my morning—thanks team :sun_with_face:
